properties.name: Klebelsberg-telep
properties.sourcePeriod: KSH2003 fine-unit scheme reproduced by Henits2013; original delineation era is not current
properties.method: Exact interior source-pixel cells of the observed closed quarter boundary. Estimated geographic placement by a manually interpreted six-road-junction EOV similarity; inverse projection to WGS84. No invented closing edge, clipping, snapping or geometry repair.

registrationCompanion.role: Physical road-junction identification only; source number keys are not transferred wholesale.

properties.license: Academic/KSH map redistribution rights not independently established; ODbL applies to OSM road controls and current-name evidence.
properties.sourceSchemaIdentityNotes: Only independently keyed source units are emitted. Tarján source versions and Felsőváros planning conflict are deferred;32/34 and Bodomi27 discrepancies are not resolved by renaming.
properties.nameNormalizationEvidence: Henits prints Klebersberg-telep. Corrected Klebelsberg spelling is independently present in KSH2014 and the2007local-history original; OSM Klebelsbergtelep has Hattyas as loc_name. The distinct southern Hattyas point is retained as separate evidence, not merged or used for placement.
